comparison.objective: Secure a bar in a lathe chuck and return the chuck key, rather than finish HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bar centering, chuck-key insertion and torque, workholding verification, and key removal versus narrow-mandrel alignment, striking, and loose-tang recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies a properly chucked bar with the key put away; body supplies no runout, torque, or safety rubric. It has no fracture or four-fragment containment requirement.
comparison.reason: Tool insertion is generic overlap only; rotary workholding and key-removal safety test a different mechanism and final state.
